mapper.select: SELECT id, uuid, voucher_no AS voucherNo, occurred_on AS occurredOn, project_id AS projectId, level_1_subject AS level1Subject, level_2_subject AS level2Subject, summary, transaction_direction AS transactionDirection, tax_rate AS taxRate, counterparty_customer_id AS counterpartyCustomerId, counterparty_name_snapshot AS counterpartyNameSnapshot, invoice_status AS invoiceStatus, invoice_no AS invoiceNo, invoice_amount AS invoiceAmount, actual_income_amount AS actualIncomeAmount, actual_expense_amount AS actualExpenseAmount, booked_amount AS bookedAmount, is_completed AS isCompleted, remark, created_at AS createdAt, created_by AS createdBy, updated_at AS updatedAt, updated_by AS updatedBy FROM finance_voucher WHERE uuid = #{uuid}

SELECT id, uuid, voucher_no AS voucherNo, occurred_on AS occurredOn, project_id AS projectId, level_1_subject AS level1Subject, level_2_subject AS level2Subject, summary, transaction_direction AS transactionDirection, tax_rate AS taxRate, counterparty_customer_id AS counterpartyCustomerId, counterparty_name_snapshot AS counterpartyNameSnapshot, invoice_status AS invoiceStatus, invoice_no AS invoiceNo, invoice_amount AS invoiceAmount, actual_income_amount AS actualIncomeAmount, actual_expense_amount AS actualExpenseAmount, booked_amount AS bookedAmount, is_completed AS isCompleted, remark, created_at AS createdAt, created_by AS createdBy, updated_at AS updatedAt, updated_by AS updatedBy FROM finance_voucher WHERE voucher_no = #{voucherNo} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, uuid, voucher_no AS voucherNo, occurred_on AS occurredOn, project_id AS projectId, level_1_subject AS level1Subject, level_2_subject AS level2Subject, summary, transaction_direction AS transactionDirection, tax_rate AS taxRate, counterparty_customer_id AS counterpartyCustomerId, counterparty_name_snapshot AS counterpartyNameSnapshot, invoice_status AS invoiceStatus, invoice_no AS invoiceNo, invoice_amount AS invoiceAmount, actual_income_amount AS actualIncomeAmount, actual_expense_amount AS actualExpenseAmount, booked_amount AS bookedAmount, is_completed AS isCompleted, remark, created_at AS createdAt, created_by AS createdBy, updated_at AS updatedAt, updated_by AS updatedBy FROM finance_voucher ORDER BY occurred_on DESC, voucher_no DESC

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO finance_voucher ( uuid, voucher_no, occurred_on, project_id, level_1_subject, level_2_subject, summary, transaction_direction, tax_rate, counterparty_customer_id, counterparty_name_snapshot, invoice_status, invoice_no, invoice_amount, actual_income_amount, actual_expense_amount, booked_amount, is_completed, remark, created_at, created_by ) VALUES ( #{uuid}, #{voucherNo}, #{occurredOn}, #{projectId}, #{level1Subject}, #{level2Subject}, #{summary}, #{transactionDirection}, #{taxRate}, #{counterpartyCustomerId}, #{counterpartyNameSnapshot}, #{invoiceStatus}, #{invoiceNo}, #{invoiceAmount}, #{actualIncomeAmount}, #{actualExpenseAmount}, #{bookedAmount}, #{isCompleted}, #{remark}, NOW(), #{createdBy} )
